```{r}
dat_neu <- openesm::get_dataset("0001_fried")$data[, c("id", 
"scheduled", "issued", "response", "difficulties_relaxing", "irritable", "worry", "nervous")]

head(dat_neu)
```

```{r}
dat_neu %>%
  tidyr::drop_na("difficulties_relaxing") |>
  count(id, name = "n_datapoints")
```

```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(clustinvar)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
dat_neu <- dplyr::rename(dat_neu,
              neu.1 = difficulties_relaxing,
              neu.2 = irritable,
              neu.3 = worry,
              neu.4 = nervous)
```

```{r}
names(dat_neu)
```

```{r}
descriptives <- psych::describe(
  dplyr::select(dat_neu,
                neu.1,
                neu.2,
                neu.3,
                neu.4)
)

View(descriptives)
```


```{r}
model <- '
level: 1
neu =~ neu.1 + neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4

level:2
neu.1 ~~ neu.2 + neu.3 + neu.4
neu.2 ~~ neu.3 + neu.4
neu.3 ~~ neu.4
'

fit <- cfa(
  model,
  data = dat_neu,
  cluster = "id"
)
```

```{r}
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

```{r}
config_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit._measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "cfi", "srmr"),
  constraint = "none",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(config_results)
```
```{r}
metric_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit_measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "srmr"),
  constraint = "loadings",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(metric_results)
```

```{r}
lv_variance_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit_measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "srmr"),
  constraint = "lv.variances",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(lv_variance_results)
```

```{r}
residuals_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit_measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "srmr"),
  constraint = "residuals",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(residuals_results)
```

```{r}
homogeneity_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit,
  fit_measures = c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "rmsea", "srmr"),
  constraint = "all",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(homogeneity_results)
```
```{r}
subset(homogeneity_results, rmsea.swain < 0.80)
```
```{r}
pool_cluster_chisq(config_results)
```
```{r}
fit_robust <- cfa(
model,
data = dat_neu,
cluster = "cluster",
estimator = "MLR"
)

scaled_results <- cluster_fit(
  fit_robust,
  constraint = "None",
  check.gradient = FALSE,
  warn = FALSE
)

head(scaled_results)

omnibus_result <- pool_cluster_chisq(scaled_results)
print(omnibus_result)
```
